thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: control-plane - elevated 5xx rate (auth/org lookup) — P1 — paging on-call

Alice Kim: I'm on it. Seeing 5xx spikes from control-plane gateway around 14:02 UTC. Latency also climbing.

Bob Singh: Confirmed, dashboards show auth upstream 502 and org-lookup 504s. Spike started ~14:00 UTC across us-west-2.

Carla Mendoza: Logs show a surge of retries to org-lookup with 429/504 cascading to gateway. Possible heartbeat loop after recent config push.

Daniel Stein: Any deploys in the last 30m? I didn't see a prod config rollout but will check CI.

Alice Kim: No deploys on control-plane from prod deploy bot. But config service shows increased error rate on read path.

ops-bot: Runbook link: https://internal.runbooks.redwood/ctrlplane-5xx - Step 1: identify offending dependency. Step 2: open emergency ticket.

Frank Liu (IC): Frank taking incident lead. Alice/Carla you pair on root cause. Bob handle temporary routing fallback. Eve, prepare customer comms.

Eve Harper (CS): I'll draft an initial status for impacted customers + internal comms. Any ETA on mitigation?

Carla Mendoza: quick grep of gateway logs: repeated errors from org-lookup service: "error=timeout while waiting for indexer". Seems to be a downstream DB latency, maybe backpressure.

Bob Singh: Initiating policy: route control-plane auth calls to standby auth replica (fallback policy) and enable bypass-cache for critical token lookups. Applying in 1-2m.

Alice Kim: Before we flip, what's risk? Will traffic exceed standby capacity?

Carla Mendoza: Standby has headroom for small bursts. We'll throttle non-critical flows (batch syncs) first.

Frank Liu (IC): Do it. Bob, add a short-lived circuit-breaker increase to avoid mass failures. Keep trace IDs.

Bob Singh: Executing change: 
```bash
# apply temporary routing override
redwoodctl route set --service control-plane/auth --to auth-replica-02 --reason "emergency fallback"
```

ops-bot: Action recorded: routing override by bob.singh at 14:05 UTC.

Alice Kim: After routing override, overall 5xx dropped ~40% in the first 30s. But org-lookup timeouts still present for some tenants.

Carla Mendoza: Patching a quick mitigation on org-lookup: disable expensive enrichment path (feature flag) to reduce DB fanout. Rolling to 10% then 100% if stable.

Daniel Stein: Seen a config service TTL change earlier today — could that have increased cache misses?

Carla Mendoza: Good catch — config TTL reduced from 60s -> 5s in a small rollout. That will cause heavy read amplification. Rolling TTL back now.

Bob Singh: Metrics: auth 5xx back down to baseline after routes + TTL rollback. Org-lookup p95 latency still high for ~5% of requests but error rate trending down.

Eve Harper (CS): Draft posted to #status: "We're investigating elevated errors affecting login and org-related requests. Mitigation in progress; no data loss suspected. Updates every 15m." Thoughts?

Frank Liu (IC): Good. Mark P1, start customer impact tracker doc and add affected customer list. Also open incident ticket (INC-4315) and assign follow-ups.

Alice Kim: Opening pager-handoff to morning on-call at 15:00 UTC. Current mitigation: routing fallback + TTL revert + feature flag disable.

Carla Mendoza: Will continue to watch for residual retries. Also engage DB on-call to look for slow queries around 13:58-14:06 UTC.

ops-bot: Pager handoff scheduled to Amanda at 15:00 UTC. Handoff note: mitigations applied, monitor for 30m stable before close.

Daniel Stein: FYI I traced a sample span: 
```json
{"trace_id":"abc123","service":"org-lookup","span_ms":1200,"db_query":"SELECT ... WHERE tenant_id IN (...)"}
```
This query exploded because TTL drop increased churn.

Frank Liu (IC): Postmortem owners: Carla + Bob. Deep-dive items: 1) why TTL change rolled without perf tests, 2) fallback automation gaps, 3) customer comms cadence.

Eve Harper (CS): I'll follow up with the two top-enterprise customers impacted and provide an RCA ETA.

Alice Kim: Monitoring shows stable for 12m. Error rate back within SLO (slight blip). Keeping incident open for handoff.

Frank Liu (IC): Thanks team. Next update at handoff. Create follow-up ticket to add auto-detection to prevent TTL rollouts below 30s for config service.

Bob Singh: Logged mitigation actions and reverted change set. Will schedule a canary with perf tests before any future TTL change.

incident-bot: Incident INC-4315 created; severity=P1; status=mitigated->monitoring; assigned_to=frank.liu; slack-thread=4315000000

Eve Harper (CS): Closing note to CS: we should proactively reach out to two customers that reported errors and offer a sync.

Alice Kim: Handing off to Amanda (on-call) at 15:00 UTC. Handoff message appended to ticket.

ops-bot: Reminder: please file a postmortem within 72h and tag #postmortems.

Frank Liu (IC): End of thread for now. Thanks all.
